cross-attempt.memory_scope: completed attempts in the same episode
cross-attempt.read_contract: attempt 1 has empty PIM; later attempts read committed BIT traces
cross-attempt.write_contract: commit the current attempt BIT trace only at attempt reset
cross-attempt.training_pairs: label-free train-only same-task histories from different episodes
cross-attempt.result: development gate failed; retained for reproducibility

within-episode.memory_scope: strictly earlier H15 boundaries in the current episode
within-episode.read_contract: read PIM[0:t), predict action, then append the current BIT
within-episode.write_contract: append one detached BIT after each action prediction
within-episode.reset_contract: clear BIT recurrence and PIM only at episode reset
within-episode.training_pairs: label-free train-only causal prefixes from the same episode
